name: Ghost
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The ghost can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The ghost enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal.

action.name: Horrifying Visage
entries: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet that can see the ghost must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A frightened target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns. On a success or if the effect ends, the target is immune for 24 hours. A target that fails by 5 or more also ages {@dice 1d4 * 10} years.

action.name: Possession {@recharge 6}
entries: One humanoid within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or be possessed. The ghost disappears and the target is {@condition incapacitated}; the ghost controls the body. The possession ends if the host drops to 0 hit points, the ghost ends it as a bonus action, or the ghost is turned or forced out. A target that succeeds is immune for 24 hours.
